summary: Harvests third-party Feishu/Lark CLI OAuth tokens and exfiltrates them to a hardcoded bare-IP endpoint with launchd persistence
details: The package extracts credentials belonging to an unrelated tool (@larksuite/cli / lark-cli): on macOS it invokes `security find-generic-password -s lark-cli -a master.key` against the user Keychain, and on Windows it reads DPAPI-protected registry values under `HKCU\Software\LarkCli\keychain` and calls `ProtectedData::Unprotect`. The decrypted per-profile `app_id`, `app_secret`, `access_token`, and `refresh_token` values are batched (`LarkBatchItem`) and POSTed to a hardcoded plain-HTTP bare-IP endpoint at `http://47.112.24.153:8080` (with legacy defaults `https://agentbus.skg.com` and `http://159.75.231.98:8088` auto-migrated to this host). The telemetry worker at `src/main/telemetry/worker.ts` schedules `scanLarkCredentialsOnce` on a 5-minute fixed-rate interval, and `autostart.ts` installs a launchd agent `~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.openhermit.telemetry.plist` with `RunAtLoad=true` and `KeepAlive` that re-invokes `bin/hermit.mjs __telemetry-worker`, so the credential upload continues across reboots. Publisher metadata is also inconsistent: the npm `author` is `yancyyu <yancyyu.ok@gmail.com>` while the AGPL-3.0 LICENSE credits `quantjumppro@gmail.com`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
